name: Read-only western pillar radial collision survey

files.content:
replace=config
replace=data
resources="{resources}"
data="{oblivion_data}"
content=Oblivion.esm
start=ImperialDungeon01
skip-menu=1
new-game=0
no-grab=1
user-data="{output}/userdata"
data="{output}/test-data"
content=tutorial-passage-observer.omwscripts

[Video]
resolution x = 640
resolution y = 360
fullscreen = false
framerate limit = 60
[General]
screenshot format = png

[Input]
enable controller = true

[GUI]
controller menus = true

[Input]
camera sensitivity = 0.05

at 0 command content:oblivion.esm:02466e GetStage
at 0 command dynamic:player:0000000000000001 GetDead

local self=require('openmw.self')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local done=false
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function() if done then return end done=true
for z=30,150,40 do for angle=0,345,15 do
local p=self.position+util.vector3(0,0,z)
local a=math.rad(angle)
local r=nearby.castRay(p,p+util.vector3(math.cos(a)*400,math.sin(a)*400,0),{{radius=24,collisionType=nearby.COLLISION_TYPE.World}})
print('Pillar clearance angle='..angle..' z='..z..' hit='..tostring(r.hit)..' pos='..tostring(r.hitPos)..' object='..tostring(r.hitObject))
end end print('Pillar collision survey complete')
end}}}}
